note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Larne rural district, one member each. Twelve divisions were nominated; the Middle Division alone was contested, polling on Thursday 5 June 1924. Five divisions made no nomination and were filled by co-option at the first meeting. Houston, 270; Wilson, the retiring member, 213; majority 57. Poll of about 78 per cent.
